subject: Renewal & Expansion Roadmap — MAP Kickoff for CloudHaven
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudhaven.com>, Maya Khanna <maya.khanna@cloudhaven.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Renewal & Expansion Roadmap — MAP Kickoff for CloudHaven

Hi Sanjay / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. As CloudHaven’s renewal approaches, we put together a mutual action plan (MAP) to align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic close timeline that includes the expansion items we discussed (additional tokens, private VPC, and extended observability retention).

Attached are two starter items: CloudHaven_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (draft MAP with milestones) and usage_report_Apr2026.csv (last 90-day usage summary). High-level proposal: a 5-week MAP with these checkpoints:

- Week 1 (this week): Confirm stakeholders & success metrics; procurement intro
- Week 2: Usage deep-dive + preliminary upsell sizing (tokens & retention)
- Week 3: Security/compliance review (KMS/HSM, audit logs)
- Week 4: Commercial terms + legal redlines; draft SOW and DocuSign prep
- Week 5: Final approvals + go/no-go / kickoff of additional capacity

Who I’d like on the thread from your side: the primary sponsor, the technical owner for integrations, and procurement. Can you confirm names or add people?

Internal owners from our side: Marcus (renewal lead / pricing), Karthik (solutions & security touchpoints), Laura (CS for onboarding + usage ops). I’ll own mapping timeline and follow-ups.

Proposed next step: 30-min MAP kickoff meeting this Tuesday or Wednesday to lock stakeholders and the Week 1 deliverables. Please reply with availability or add a calendar invite.

Thanks — excited to align and move quickly.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: CloudHaven_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
Attachment: usage_report_Apr2026.csv (CSV, 42 KB)

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@cloudhaven.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Khanna <maya.khanna@cloudhaven.com>, procurement@cloudhaven.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 10:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion Roadmap — MAP Kickoff for CloudHaven

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good as a starting point.

Quick notes from our side:
- I’m the executive sponsor; Maya will be the technical owner and will lead the security review.
- I’ve looped in our procurement alias to start the commercial/PO discussion. Procurement will need an initial SOW and standard terms (we use a vendor scorecard).
- Data residency: we need confirmation that audit logs and billing data can be retained in the US region only — is that supported for the expanded retention window?

Availability: Wednesday 13 May after 11:00 AM ET works for Maya and me for a 30-min kickoff.

Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
VP Product, CloudHaven
sanjay.patel@cloudhaven.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Expansion Roadmap — MAP Kickoff for CloudHaven

All — I’ll own commercial coordination and upsell sizing. A couple of operational notes and proposed deliverables from Redwood’s side: 

- Week 1 deliverable (by end of week): confirmed stakeholder RACI + final MAP PDF we can hand to procurement.
- Week 2 deliverable: a recommended upsell package (tokens + retention tier) modeled from CloudHaven’s April usage; I’ll include a cost/benefit table.
- Week 3: Karthik to lead the security checklist (KMS integration plan and audit log specs).
- We should also run a quick cost sensitivity run in the Console to show incremental cost at the 2x and 3x usage levels — I can share a recording.

I’ve added the following items to the shared Drive (link below): a) MAP v1 (editable), b) PO checklist for procurement, c) a short screen recording showing cost deltas. I’ll start an internal thread with legal if we see any non-standard redlines early.

Propose kickoff Wednesday 13 May at 11:30 AM ET — sending a calendar invite now.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/CH-2026-082 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_MAP

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 13:05:00 +00:00
Subject: RE: Renewal & Expansion Roadmap — MAP Kickoff for CloudHaven

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Wednesday 13 May at 11:30 AM ET (calendar invite sent).

To summarize next steps and owners before the kickoff:
- Jasmine (me): finalize MAP PDF and circulate Week 1 checklist (stakeholder RACI + required procurement docs).
- Marcus: upsell packaging and cost sensitivity report (deliverable for Week 2).
- Karthik: security checklist draft for Week 3 (KMS/HSM plan + audit log retention confirmation).
- CloudHaven (Sanjay/Maya): confirm procurement contact and any corporate legal templates; confirm data residency requirement (US-only) so Karthik can validate compliance.

I’ve updated the MAP with the items discussed and uploaded it to the Drive. For procurement: I’ll prepare an SOW template and a DocuSign envelope with the standard terms so procurement can review in Week 4 if things progress.

If anything needs to be added ahead of Wednesday, reply-all and I’ll incorporate. Looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
